candidate.statement: Microsatellite instability-high (MSI-H) colorectal cancer cell lines exhibit pronounced synthetic lethal dependency on the WRN helicase compared to microsatellite stable lines.
queries: WRN dependency MSI colorectal cancer CRISPR

review.rationale: Multiple provided abstracts directly confirm the synthetic lethal dependency on the WRN helicase in microsatellite instability-high (MSI-H) colorectal cancer cells compared to microsatellite stable (MSS) cells. For example, MED:42484294 highlights that MSI-H colorectal cancer cells depend on WRN to resolve cruciform DNA structures. MED:40767886 explicitly notes that tumors with MSI depend on WRN, which induces selective DNA damage and death in MSI tumors while sparing microsatellite stable (MSS) cells. Furthermore, MED:40203476 and MED:38587317 corroborate that MSI colorectal cancer cells specifically require WRN for survival (a synthetic lethal target), matching all criteria of population, exposure/comparator (MSI-H vs MSS), outcome (WRN dependency), and negative direction (increased dependency/lethality).
